title: Monitor an airline agent and improve its tests
question: What will you build, and how will you know it works?
summary: A passenger changes the outbound flight. The booking API replaces the whole itinerary, so a successful call can still erase the return journey. Investigate the behavior before writing a monitoring rule.

steps.body: Replay incidents and test a repair.
